payers_information.standard_charge_algorithm: Fee schedule rate ($240.57).    This procedure could have the cardiovascular rule applied to it.  When a claim contains two or more procedures that the cardiovascular rule applies to with the same date of service, they are considered together for the cardiovascular reduction.  If the procedures are reported as global diagnostic procedures (i.e. without 26 or TC modifier) and with the same date of service, each procedure is split (for calculation purposes only) into the professional component (PC) and is given the 26 modifier and technical component (TC) and is given the TC modifier.
